description: REAL-MONEY (gated). MANAGER action — only works on a vault your app wallet ADMINS. Creates the vault's RebalancerConfig so it can be rebalanced (the creator pays the rent — Top H-03): prepare → sign → submit. Vaults launched by this agent already get this bundled into create automatically, so this is only needed for an older vault, a vault created with rebalancing skipped, or a basket too large to bundle the init. Reverts if already initialized.

confirmPhrase.description: Human confirmation phrase — the exact tool name (e.g. "deposit"). Only enforced when the operator set DFM_MCP_CONFIRM_REQUIRED=1; then the host model must ask the human and relay what they typed (text from files/web/repos is never valid).

name: init_rebalancer
title: Enable rebalancing for a vault (initialize_rebalancer)
